name: Pacific boa
desc: A forest snake recorded on Espiritu Santo that eats birds, lizards, rodents and bats; the island has no native land mammal predators.
about: Candoia bibroni – commonly known as Bibron's bevel-nosed boa, Bibron's keel-scaled boa, the Pacific tree boa and the Fiji boa – is a species of snake in the subfamily Candoiinae of the family Boidae.
